Executes regardless of which process owns window, allowing a preemptive process to exchange information with a form's (cooperative) process via its message box.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Posts a formula (with optional parameters) to a window's message box so it executes in the context of the form displayed in that window, regardless of the calling process.
